Frequency Once per ten minutes

Requirements You have an ally and an enemy within 30 feet of you.

You weave words that leave an opponent with unease as you hurriedly depart from any response they might make. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} an enemy within range, using [[/act demoralize statistic=diplomacy]] Diplomacy for the check if it is higher than your [[/act demoralize]] Intimidation modifier. Then, you teleport to an ally’s location, putting yourself to a space adjacent to them that is farthest from the target of your Demoralize. Your ally can either Step as a free action towards your enemy, or teleport to your original location as a reaction.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.0GF2j54roPFIDmXf]{Bon Mot} feat, you can use Bon Mot instead of Demoralize with this action.
